head: 7a2c8b9
summary: Third confirmation on 7a2c8b9. git diff --stat 8467f01 HEAD -- src touches 04_shaders.js, 07_shell.js, 09_seats.js, 09b_py.js, 09d_suite.js and 12_scene.js. 10_mono.js and 05_layout.js are unchanged, so monument geometry, materials and atlas are the same as at the 8.7 head. Old vs new pixel diff (|dL|>8 / |dB-R|>8): m01, m03, m05, m12, q01 and q19 0.00 % / 0.00 % (pixel-identical). q11 0.19/0.10 % and m06 0.30/0.18 % come only from the PY glimpse past the bar cheek (q11 x614-674, rows 181-240), not from the bar. The changed views are q13 (26.1/9.4 %), m08 (50.0/38.7 %), m10 (32.3/17.3 %) and m09 (47.5/43.2 %). In all four the change is the L17/L18 pyCool/pyLvl term above seat level. On the PY-facing monuments it moves towards py_37302, as intended. Whites B-R, old -> new vs the photo: q13 rear wall +3 -> +11 (photo +8); q13 right partition +2 -> +10 (photo +17); m10 rear wall whites +2 -> +12; m08 J/PY bulkhead PY face +9 -> +24 (py_37301/37303 lower whites +25..+36). One new lighting regression on a monument: in m09 the door-4 galley's upper inserts (the face that looks aft into the door-4 cross-aisle, not into PY) take the full PY cool share. L goes 139 -> 110, B-R goes -5 -> +13 (slate blue), while the lower full-depth body below the work deck stays neutral (counter panel 167 / -3, identical). That splits the galley face at deck height, the same failure mode as the L14 medium. Cause: monoStepBody sets the upper body back by about 0.3 m (up.z1 = m.z1 - set), so it sits forward of the pyM end ramp (u_pyCool.y - 0.3 .. u_pyCool.y, u_pyCool.y = doorsZ[3][0] = galley z1). This is lighting, routed to the integrator and not scored. The monument score holds at 8.7. There is no high issue. The one medium is lighting, not scored.
lighting_note: Not scored. (1) MEDIUM, new regression (L17/L18): the door-4 galley's aft face (m09) is tinted PY-cool and dimmed above the work deck. Measured old -> new: upper cart doors (270-400, 40-120) L p50 139 -> 110, B-R -5 -> +13, RGB (141,140,136) -> (107,111,119); right doors (600-740, 40-120) 140 -> 111, -5 -> +13; top frame B-R -4 -> +13; lower inserts (100-240, 240-340) 122 -> 116, -7 -> -2 (partial); below-counter panel (100-700, 400-480) 167 / -3, unchanged. This face looks into the door-4 cross-aisle, not into PY: no PY photo shows it, and galley task light is neutral. The comment in mainFS says 'the door-4 zone and its galleys stay out (z end)', but the upper body is set back about 0.3 m (10_mono.js monoStepBody, up.z1 = m.z1 - set; the galley z1 = doorsZ[3][0] = u_pyCool.y; 05_layout.js line 341/342), so it lies forward of the 0.3 m end ramp at pyM about 1. Fix (04_shaders.js pyM): exclude aft-facing surfaces near the PY end, e.g. pyM *= 1.0 - step(0.5, N.z) * smoothstep(u_pyCool.y - 1.2, u_pyCool.y - 0.9, v_wpos.z). Alternatively, end the ramp for N.z > 0.5 at u_pyCool.y - 0.9 .. -0.6. The PY rear wall's forward faces (N.z < -0.5) keep their share. Re-check m09: upper inserts back to L about 139, B-R about -5. (2) Low: with pyLvl 0.65 the PY-facing monument whites now read darker than py_37302. q13 rear wall L 208 -> 190 (photo 218); right partition 191 -> 176 (photo 215). The hue now matches; the level is the integrator's trade-off against the q13 top band. (3) Carried, unchanged: the bar's open bays are crushed to L3, the black soffit sits over the bar, the m05 counter shows no reflections, the q11 ash doors run bright, and the door-5 cart faces are slightly cool (B-R -8; q19/m12 pixel-identical to confirm2).
